caption:
Slab dhalai se pehle cover block check kiya kya?

Bina proper cover block ke sariya bahar dikhne lagta hai aur jung lagne ka khatra badhta hai. Hamesha sahi spacing rakhein (structural details apne site engineer se confirm karein).

Smooth concrete finish aur behtar dhalai ke liye switch kijiye VAJRA PP shuttering sheet par.
